set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Compile identity and affine volume-domain paths into sampled target-by-source operators over NeuroSpace. Acceptance: CompileRequest is pure and inspectable, target coordinates are enumerated zero-based, trilinear weights are normalized, ROI rows are supported, out-of-bounds rows report coverage, provenance records path and sampling policy, and toy JVM+JS tests pass.
set.title: Operator compiler: affine volume-to-volume projectors
